# RunnableBuilder::at_end behavior in xpcom/rust/moz_task/src/dispatcher.rs

Sets or clears the at-end flag. When enabling the flag, the caller must ensure that dispatch occurs from an event on the same target that is about to finish; passing false only clears the flag.

## State read

- self.options
- argument

## State changed

- self.options

## Calls and triggers

- DispatchOptions::at_end in lib.rs:178-185 uses OR or AND with complement.

## Result and consumers

Returns the updated owned builder for chaining.

## Errors

No Result branch. The unsafe same-target/about-to-finish requirement applies when enabling the flag.

## Async completion

Synchronous option change; no dispatch.

## Ownership and cleanup

Consumes and returns the builder; callback ownership is retained.
